decisions.decision: Defer BRAND-01 domain registration; proceed with free Render/Vercel subdomains for now
decisions.rationale: User was unfamiliar with domain registration and wanted to avoid the cost/friction right now. Nothing in plan 02-05/02-06 technically requires the domain — Cors__WebOrigin and NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL both explicitly support provisional *.vercel.app values, with the real domain swapped in later at 02-06 with zero code changes. The plan's own acceptance criteria already allow escalating a failed/deferred registration as a documented STATE.md blocker instead of a hard stop.
